longPeriodsBetweenCaseOnset.description: Number of days used for defining long periods in the dates of onset between cases in the chain of transmission

periodOfFollowup.description: Duration for the follow-up period in days

frequencyOfFollowUp.description: Frequency of follow ups in days (once every X days/daily)

frequencyOfFollowUpPerDay.description: Number of follow ups to be generated per day

generateFollowUpsOverwriteExisting.description: Flag specifying whether existing follow-ups in the specified period will be overwritten or not. Applies only to not performed follow-ups

generateFollowUpsKeepTeamAssignment.description: Flag specifying whether new generated follow-ups will be assigned to the same team as the last follow-up for a contact or the team assignment will be made through round-robin (can be true only if 'generateFollowUpsOverwriteExisting' is false)

generateFollowUpsTeamAssignmentAlgorithm.description: Option specifying whether the round-robin team assignment should be done taking in consideration all teams activating in the contact's location (via that location or parents) or just the nearest teams. Default: round-robin of all teams activating in the contact's location

generateFollowUpsDateOfLastContact.description: Flag specifying if contact tracing should start on the date of the last contact

generateFollowUpsWhenCreatingContacts.description: Flag that specifies whether follow ups are automatically generated when creating contacts. Default: false

intervalOfFollowUp.description: Option specifying the interval when follow-ups should be generated. If empty then no restrictions will be applied, otherwise it will generate follow-ups only on specific days (interval sample: '1, 3, 5')

noDaysAmongContacts.description: Number of days used to calculate the proportion of new cases detected among known contacts

noDaysInChains.description: Number of days used to calculate the proportion of new cases in known transmission chains

noDaysNotSeen.description: Number of days used to filter a list of contacts not seen for a specific number of days

noLessContacts.description: Number of contacts used to determine the proportion of cases with less than X contacts

noDaysNewContacts.description: Number of days used to determine if a contact is new

reportingGeographicalLevelId.description: The maximum geographical level of locations from which reports data is gathered

applyGeographicRestrictions.description: Flag specifying whether the geographical restriction of data will be applied for the outbreak

checkLastContactDateAgainstDateOnSet.description: Flag specifying whether Date of Last Contact that is BEFORE the Date of Onset of source case. Default: false

disableModifyingLegacyQuestionnaire.description: Flag specifying if the modifying of the legacy questionnaire is disabled. Default: false

allowCasesFollowUp.description: Flag specifying if the cases follow-up is allowed. Default: false

periodOfFollowupCases.description: Duration for the follow-up period in days

frequencyOfFollowUpCases.description: Frequency of follow ups in days (once every X days/daily)

frequencyOfFollowUpPerDayCases.description: Number of follow ups to be generated per day

intervalOfFollowUpCases.description: Option specifying the interval when follow-ups should be generated. If empty then no restrictions will be applied, otherwise it will generate follow-ups only on specific days (interval sample: '1, 3, 5')

generateFollowUpsKeepTeamAssignmentCases.description: Flag specifying whether new generated follow-ups will be assigned to the same team as the last follow-up for a case or the team assignment will be made through round-robin (can be true only if 'generateFollowUpsOverwriteExisting' is false)

generateFollowUpsTeamAssignmentAlgorithm.description: Option specifying whether the round-robin team assignment should be done taking in consideration all teams activating in the case's location (via that location or parents) or just the nearest teams. Default: round-robin of all teams activating in the case's location

generateFollowUpsDateOfOnset.description: Flag specifying if case tracing should start on the date of onset

generateFollowUpsWhenCreatingCases.description: Flag that specifies whether follow ups are automatically generated when creating cases. Default: false
